question: A man spends 40% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹442 on conveyance and ₹9,115 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹946, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Monthly Salary** be 100%.

**Expenditure on Rent** = 40%

**Remaining Salary** = 100% − 40% = 60%

This 60% equals the sum of **Conveyance**, **Grocery**, and **Savings**.

60% = ₹442 + ₹9,115 + ₹946 = ₹10,503

100% = (₹10,503 ÷ 60) × 100 = ₹17,505

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,505.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed96c1be87c1bc7581ca3484c37460a49fa80554a6ecb672fdbcbd782c9433a7.png] 

**Given:**

**Rent Expenditure** = 40% of Salary

**Conveyance** = ₹442

**Grocery** = ₹9,115

**Savings** = ₹946

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total non-rent amount = ₹(442 + 9,115 + 946)

⇒ Total non-rent amount = ₹10,503

⇒ Let total salary be S.

⇒ S − 40% of S = ₹10,503

⇒ 60% of S = ₹10,503

⇒ (60 ÷ 100) × S = 10,503

⇒ S = (10,503 × 100) ÷ 60

⇒ S = 10,503 × (5 ÷ 3)

⇒ S = 3,501 × 5 = ₹17,505

**∴ The correct answer is ₹17,505.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Expenditure

Total Income is always considered 100%. Total Income = Savings + Total Expenditure.

Successive Percentage

If spending is done on the **remaining** amount, use the formula: Final = Initial × (100−r₁)/100 × (100−r₂)/100.

Base Change Rule

When calculating percentage increase/decrease, always ensure the **denominator (base)** corresponds to the original value.
